title: Fantasy Foosball Year 8, 2026: Week 11 Preview
subtitle: With six playoff spots available, the model sees sharply different levels of urgency across this week's matchups.

playoffModel.description: Seeded Monte Carlo estimate using current record, scoring strength and remaining Sleeper schedule.

matchups.headline: A heavyweight matchup with limited downside for Payton
matchups.paragraph: Payton’s I ♥️ Big Tet-Tees enters ranked third at 7-3, with a 99.9% modeled playoff chance. The two-time champion’s outlook barely changes: a win makes it 100%, while a loss leaves it at 99.8%. Alex’s I love big TD’s is fourth at 6-4 and carries a 98.8% chance, but the 2025 champion has more at stake. A win lifts Alex to 99.9%; a loss drops the model to 97.9%, a two-point swing.

matchups.headline: Joey faces a major playoff-odds test against Andy
matchups.paragraph: Andy’s Long dong silvers are second at 8-2, and the model gives Andy a 99% playoff chance. A win would make that 100%, while a loss lowers it to 97.9%, a manageable 2.1-point swing. Joey’s Off Constantly, ranked seventh at 5-5, has a far more consequential week: the current modeled chance is 16.1%, rising to 26.7% with a win and falling to 7.3% with a loss. Joey’s 2024 championship history adds context, but not certainty.

matchups.headline: Kane and Kade meet with meaningful playoff leverage
matchups.paragraph: Kane’s Blueballs sits fifth at 6-4 with a 92.2% modeled playoff chance, but this is not a throwaway week: a win raises the figure to 97.4%, while a loss drops it to 82.7%. Kade’s CheesusJesus is ninth at 4-6 and has only a 3.7% chance to reach the six-team field. The model gives Kade a 9.5% chance with a win and 0.6% with a loss, making this an important opportunity for both teams.

matchups.headline: Parker has a strong position, but every result matters
matchups.paragraph: Parker’s My BallDak hurts is sixth at 5-5, holding an 80.5% modeled playoff chance. A win improves that outlook to 86.8%, while a loss cuts it to 60.7%, the largest supplied swing at 26.1 points. Brae’s Ogles Outlaws, ranked 12th at 1-9, is at 0% in the current model, and that remains 0% with either result. Parker, the 2019 inaugural champion and league’s Public Enemy, has the clear playoff stakes here.

matchups.headline: CJ needs a breakthrough against an already-secure Evan
matchups.paragraph: Evan’s Bonnie Blue 42 is first at 8-2 and already has a 100% modeled playoff chance; that figure stays 100% whether Evan wins or loses. The 2023 champion therefore faces little change in playoff outlook. CJ’s cjbroadway23, ranked eighth at 4-6, is in a much more volatile position with a 9.6% chance to reach the six playoff spots. A win raises CJ’s modeled chance to 20.6%, while a loss lowers it to 4.7%, a 15.9-point swing.

matchups.headline: A low-odds matchup with only a narrow path remaining
